applicable_when: The kernel spends 60% of cycles with no eligible warp, almost entirely due to 8-way shared memory bank conflicts on tl.dot implicit shared staging. The current scalar pointer arithmetic (offs_k + k_idx*BLOCK_K indexing) produces non-coalesced shared memory access patterns causing 221M bank conflicts. On Hopper (H200), TMA descriptors perform bulk async copies into shared memory with hardware-managed address generation, bypassing the scalar load path that causes bank conflicts. Switching to tl.make_tensor_descriptor + tl.load with tensor descriptors will eliminate the bank conflict stalls, reduce MIO scoreboard stalls, and free SM cycles. Additionally, increasing BLOCK_K from 32 to 64 and enabling num_stages=3 software pipelining will hide remaining memory latency.
